title: Sky Ecosystem Q3 2026 Quarterly Report
headline: Sky Frontier Foundation published the Sky Ecosystem Q3 2026 Quarterly Report, citing net revenue of $37.19 million, up 11.8% quarter on quarter.
summary: A forum post announces the Sky Ecosystem Q3 2026 Quarterly Report from Sky Frontier Foundation. The post lists these highlights: net revenue of $37.19 million (+11.8% QoQ); gross protocol revenue of $99.29 million (+14.2% YoY); $100 million in sUSDS added to Galaxy's balance sheet; $375 million in loans financed through the Grove-Galaxy Facility; the first burn of SKY, with 2.86 million SKY permanently burned; and the claim that Sky is the first stablecoin protocol rated by both Moody's and S&P Global. The post says the report gives a comprehensive overview of Q3 financial and operational developments and links to the full report on insights.skyeco.com. This is an informational report rather than a vote, and the post contains no proposal text or open questions. All figures are as reported by the foundation in the post and have not been checked against the full report.
